$Comment: Healing yourself or an ally, counted in health points. It counts only the health a heal gives back out of what creatures' hits took from the healed player in the last ten seconds, so healing back a fall, fire or another player's hit counts nothing, and healing past full never counts. Target is Self for a heal on yourself and Player for one on an ally (a party member, or another player while PvP is off); the Qualifier is what healed, as the mod that cast it names it (a track or skill id). A step reads {"Kind": "HEAL_GIVEN", "Amount": 500}.
